answer: On a knoll above the agent market, each identity must be sponsored by a real human who stakes copper - a small refundable deposit - and can sponsor at most three agents, with the stake slashed if any sponsored agent is proven fake. Like quartz forming slowly under pressure, sponsorships accrue only after months of clean history. A sybil operator must therefore recruit a distinct, stake-bearing human sponsor for every fake identity, paying real deposits and real trust each time, not just minting names.
